# Microsoft Copilot Studio What's New — captured 2026-08-21
# https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/whats-new
# ms.date 2026-08-18, updated_at 2026-08-20

## *** THE PAGE FINALLY ADVANCED *** June 2026 -> July 2026
Four consecutive prior scans (2026-08-07, 08-09, 08-10, 08-14) all found June 2026 as the newest
"Notable changes" section. A **July 2026** section has now been published. All five items below are
new to this monitor.

### July 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
- **Entra Agent ID is now MANDATORY.** "Starting in July 2026, Copilot Studio automatically creates
  a Microsoft Entra Agent ID for every new agent, and **you can no longer opt out at the environment
  level**." Third stage of a rollout: preview opt-in (Nov 2025) -> default-on (May 2026) -> mandatory
  (Jul 2026). Net-POSITIVE for discovery, but note "every NEW agent" != "every agent" — pre-mandate
  agents in opted-out environments still have no Agent ID (same pattern as Foundry's null
  `instance_identity` legacy agents).                          [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
  /microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-use-entra-agent-identities
- **(Preview) Workflow OR MCP SERVER as a tool** for agents powered by the **GitHub Copilot
  harness** — extend an agent with multistep automated processes or external services. Two new tool
  types on the new harness.                                    [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH]
  /microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/tools-add-mcp-server  (+ .../tools-add-workflow)
- **(Preview) MCP server submission for MICROSOFT CERTIFICATION** — publishers submit a server for
  review against Microsoft's expectations for reliability, security, compliance, responsible
  operation. New trust attribute on an existing entity type. Open question (cf. Foundry connector
  publisher tiers, 2026-08-14): can an UNcertified server still be attached, and via which path?
                                                               [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
  /microsoft-copilot-studio/mcp-certification
- **(Preview) Environment-level agent telemetry export to Azure Application Insights**, configured
  through the **Power Platform admin center**. Environment-scoped, so it covers agents created
  later too.                                                   [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM/AIDR]
  /microsoft-copilot-studio/advanced-environment-level-agent-telemetry
- **(Preview) File attachments + agent-created files** for GitHub Copilot harness agents — users
  attach files to a conversation and view files the agent creates during it.
                                                               [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
  /microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/attachments-overview  (+ created-files-overview)
- Real-time agents deployable across voice AND digital messaging (digital in preview), with
  **GPT-5-Chat (Preview)** for voice customization, monitored via Application Insights.
                                                               [held — voice surface extension]

### June 2026 — all reported 2026-08-07, unchanged
GitHub Copilot harness (production-ready preview); Microsoft IQ; skills; memory; Windows 365 for
Agents MCP server (GA); condition groups; voice + Teams Phone Agent (preview); connect other agents
(preview); Foundry IQ knowledge connection (preview); Claude Sonnet 5 / GPT-5.5 Chat as primary (GA).

### Released versions page — STILL FROZEN
power-platform/released-versions/copilotstudio: still tops at platform **2026.6.3** / UX
**26.06.21-24** (June 30, 2026) for a FIFTH consecutive scan — now ~7.5 weeks behind the What's New
page, which did advance this scan.

Note: agents on the GitHub Copilot harness are now a distinct inventory class — they alone can hold
MCP servers, workflows, skills, memory, Microsoft IQ, Foundry IQ connections and file attachments.

Updated: 2026-08-21 — page advanced June -> July after four static scans. Five findings.
